_comment: CANONICAL service task model — single source of truth. Mirrors index.html TASKS exactly. daily-digest.yml and weekly-summary.yml READ this file so genki-kun can never drift from the dashboard. type 'replace' = a real replacement (oil/fuel/air-filter change) that escalates to OVERDUE (red alarm) past its interval. type 'service' = a check or cleaning that past interval shows a calm DUE state and NEVER raises the overdue alarm, overdue count, or DM. airfilter_clean applies to HD5 only. If you change intervals/types here, the dashboard and genki-kun both follow. consistency-check.yml fails if index.html drifts from this file.
